events.description:
Called once something was shared: `shared` through the system share sheet, `copied` when the browser has none and
the link was copied instead (web only). Never called when the person closes the sheet.
events.name: onShare

props.description: The link to share, for example a product page.
props.name: url

props.description: The title the share sheet shows, for example the product's name.
props.name: title

props.description: A line shared with the link, for example "Look at this abaya".
props.name: text

props.description: The button's words and accessible name. Defaults to the catalogue's "Share".
props.name: label

props.description: True to draw only the share icon, named by `label`.
props.name: isIconOnly

props.description: The button's emphasis. Defaults to `secondary`, or `ghost` when icon only.
props.name: variant

props.description: True to show the button but refuse sharing.
props.name: isDisabled
